[2026-09-14 6:47:53 PM NZST] USER
how did the character who got to -12 fame lose the fame?


[2026-09-14 6:53:22 PM NZST] CODEX FINAL
Kestrel lost it by killing Alex in the Town of Solace run on August 9.

- He had fame 0 before the encounter.
- Alex (mobile vnum 10255) is flagged `ACT_LOSE_FAME` and is level 25.
- DD4's kill code applies integer `victim->level / 2`, so 25 / 2 = 12. The live transcript explicitly reported: “For your cowardly actions, you lose 12 fame!”
- The deduction happened immediately after Alex died, while Kestrel was still alive in room 10318. Kestrel died later; that caused XP loss, not fame loss, and fame remained -12.

So this was a target-selection mistake: Alex was treated as an XP target even though the source marks him as fame-negative. It was not an alignment issue. The relevant source is [fight.c](E:/dd-playtester/runs/dd4-source/server/src/fight.c:3406).
